stories.title: Launch HN: Rivet (YC W23) – Scale and Orchestrate Agents on S3
summary: This led us to extend our game server orchestrator to support what we call Rivet Actors today: many lightweight workers with in-memory state and durable storage.

Developers started using actors because they are far more memory efficient (72 KB baseline for actors vs 512 MB for a minimal sandbox) and fast to start (4.9 ms p99 for actors vs 1.7 s p99 for sandboxes).For example, Amp is using Rivet to orchestrate multiplayer agents.

Rivet’s flexible architecture lets them adapt it to their own use cases without being constrained by a framework or the memory, storage, and runtime limits of Cloudflare Durable Objects.Under the hood, Rivet is backed by S3 while maintaining SSD speeds.Why S3?
